title: Source-open transport of the comparison into derived pullback before coefficients
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume derived categories for all module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category] and derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For an open $U\subset X$, put $j=U.\iota$, $T=X\prime\times_X U$, $p:T\to X\prime$ and $q:T\to U$, and use the cartesian square $(q,pf\prime,jf,g)$. Fix $z\in T$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$. Let $H$ and $H_U$ be additive underlying derived stalk cohomology at $pz$ and $z$ [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. There is a natural isomorphism $\eta:H\cong H_U\circ Lp^*$ (in Lean functor composition order: $Lp^*\mathbin{\gg}H_U$). For every $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, K-flat complexes $P$ on $X$ and $Q$ on $U$ with invertible specified pullback counits [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], and isomorphisms $e_P:Q(P)\cong K$ and $e_Q:Q(Q)\cong Lj^*K$, let $a$ and $b$ be the underlying additive comparisonIntoPullback arrows for $P$ and $Q$ [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-pullback-naturality]. Let $\beta:Lq^*Lj^*K\to Lp^*L(g\prime)^*K$ be the canonical derived composition comparison via $qj=pg\prime$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. There is an isomorphism $l$ of the sources of $a$ and $b$ such that $a;H(L(g\prime)^*e_P);\eta_{L(g\prime)^*K}=l;b;H_U(Lq^*e_Q;\beta)$. No coefficient target object, final coefficient morphism, or target representative occurs in this assertion; no affine, boundedness, quasi-coherence or base flatness condition is imposed.

proof.text: Apply open restricted comparison transport to obtain η, the literal restriction RQ of P, its pullback counit hcR, its derived identification eR with Lj*K, and its source transport l and commuting comparison square. The literal-restriction statement also supplies the K-flatness certificate for RQ.

The derived isomorphism d=eR followed by eQ inverse identifies RQ and Q. Use exists_comparisonSourceIso to lift its canonical underlying cohomology transport to the tensor algebra; apply final scalar extension and forget scalars to obtain the source isomorphism n. comparisonIntoPullback_naturality gives the square from RQ to Q.

Compose l and n. Postcompose the representative-naturality square by HU(Lq*(eQ);β), combine it with the literal-restriction square, and simplify Lq*(d);Lq*(eQ)=Lq*(eR) using functoriality and the isomorphism inverse equation. This is exactly the requested equality.

theorem exists_open_comparisonIntoPullback_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst g' U.ι z)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let FU := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H := comparisonStalkCohomology X' (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) i ⋙ F
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology (pullback g' U.ι) z i ⋙ FU
    ∃ η : H ≅ derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ⋙ HU,
      ∀ (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hQ : Q.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
        (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
        (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K)
        (eQ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅ (derivedPullback U.ι).obj K),
      let a := F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) P hcP i)
      let b := FU.map (comparisonIntoPullback (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU z Q hcQ i)
      let β :=
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
          (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app K ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
          (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
          (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app K
      ∃ l : (Arrow.mk a).left ≅ (Arrow.mk b).left,
        a ≫ H.map ((derivedPullback g').map eP.hom) ≫
            η.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
          l.hom ≫ b ≫ HU.map ((derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).map eQ.hom ≫ β)
